invalid: Wrong email or password. After 5 wrong attempts in a row, sign-in is blocked for a while.
codeHelp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
badCode: The code is wrong or has already been used.
closed: Registration is temporarily closed. Write to {email} and we will invite you.
kindCompany: A company — issuing my own invoices
kindAccountant: An accounting firm — issuing on behalf of client companies
name: Full name
passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. No forced capitals or symbols — length is what protects you.

errors.invalidEik: The EIK is invalid — 9 or 13 digits with a correct check digit.
errors.invalidVat: The VAT number is BG + the EIK.
errors.vatMismatch: The VAT number must be BG + the same EIK.
errors.invalidIban: This is not a valid Bulgarian IBAN.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email exists.
errors.companyTaken: A company with this EIK is already registered. If you are its accounting firm, request an authorisation from your account.

password.common: This password is among the most guessed.
password.personal: The password contains your name or email.
password.repetitive: The password has too few distinct characters.

errors.companyManaged: A company with this EIK was added by its accounting firm. Ask the firm to send you an invitation from its profile — that is how you take over ownership. You can also write to us.
errors.processorDeclaration: Confirm the declaration about processing the client's data.

codeLocked: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again with your password.

invite.title: Invitation to a company profile
invite.intro: {company} (EIK {eik}) was added to Fakturist by its accounting firm. You are invited to take over its profile as the owner.
invite.forEmail: The invitation is for {email} and is valid until {date}.
invite.create: Create an account and take over the company
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {current}, but the invitation is for {email}. Sign out and open the link again.
invite.loginFirst: You already have an account with this email. Sign in and you will come back here.

errors.acceptTerms: Accept the terms and the data processing agreement.
errors.firmMember: The invitation is for the company’s owner — an employee of the accounting firm cannot accept it.

invite.byFirm: The invitation is from {firm} (EIK {eik}) — the company’s accounting firm. Mandate: {ref}, valid from {from}.
invite.confirmMandate: I confirm the mandate of {firm} — to issue documents on behalf of the company.
invite.confirmMandateHint: Ownership, members, the plan and mandates stay yours. You can revoke it at any time under “Mandates”; without the tick it waits for your decision there.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email address of your account. If there is an account with it, you will get a link for a new password — it is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If there is an account with {email}, you will get an email with a link for a new password within a minute. The link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once. Cannot see it — check your spam folder too.

reset.title: New password
reset.lead: Choose a new password for {email}. All open sessions of the account will be ended.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.

link.invalid: The link has been used, has expired or no longer belongs to this account. Ask for a new one.
link.newReset: Ask for a new password link

verify.done: Thank you! The email address of your account is confirmed.
verify.bar: Confirm your email address: we sent a link to {email}.
verify.sent: We sent a new confirmation link. Check your email.
verify.rateLimited: We have already sent several emails this hour. Try again later.
verify.already: Your email address is already confirmed.

legalAccept: I accept the {terms} and the {dpa} on behalf of {org} and declare that I may represent it or am authorised by it.

member.title: Invitation to a company account
member.intro: You are invited to the account of {company} in Fakturist with the role “{role}”.

errors.alreadyMember: You are already a member of the company.
